docs.text: RE:Pepper Project Repo: Github Discord: 3DL Decomp | 3DS Decomp | 3DL Modding (old) | 3DL Modding (new) This is RE:Pepper, an abbrevation for Reverse Engineering Super Mario 3D Land Project for the Nintendo 3DS . The focus is currently laid on the European release, but the repo has experimental multi-version support for all available versions . There are no known symbol maps for this game, however, you can use affiliated games, such as: Super Mario Odyssey: Has a full function map, including private functions. Super Mario Galaxy: The game was based on SMG2, and while we dont have its symbol map, we have that of SMG1. It was put into al:: Captain Toad Treasure Tracker (SW): Game is partly based on 3D World, and the Switch version provides symbols, while the direct 3DS version does not. Super Mario 3D World - Bowsers Fury (SW): It is a mix of Super Mario Odyssey and Super Mario 3D World, which came after 3DL. SEAD: explore debugging.games for 3DS games with SEAD/PEAD (MK7,Nintendogs,Zelda at 3DS or Tri-Force at Unmatched/3DS) Note: I fixed the map for tri-force, which has sead debug. For that, msg me on discord (moddimation) Note: RedPepper is the internal codename for Super Mario 3D Land. Code Variants Region Variant Started? docs.text: Released in 2011 by Nintendo, the game started when SMG2 ended, and was developed during a very rough year in Japan. We have the e3 build of this game, which has some parts unfinished, including that the STI for some files were included in the binary, which makes it useful for decomp (a little)
docs.title: About Game

docs.text: This project was originally run by furitty, in the github org "3dsdecomp". This is a fork, and changed a lot from the original project, including the scrap of CMAKE and making a custom build engine, so that tools can easier work together with it.

docs.text: File seadPtrUtil.h File List > include > prim > seadPtrUtil.h Go to the documentation of this file #pragma once #include <basis/seadRawPrint.h> #include <basis/seadTypes.h> namespace sead { class PtrUtil { public: // XXX: these probably do not match Nintendo's implementation static void* roundUpPow2(const void* ptr, u32 n) { const uintptr_t result = uintptr_t(ptr) + (n - uintptr_t(ptr) % n) % n; return reinterpret_cast<void*>(result); } static void* roundUpN(const void* ptr, u32 n) { const uintptr_t result = uintptr_t(ptr) + (n - uintptr_t(ptr) % n) % n; return reinterpret_cast<void*>(result); } static void* roundDownPow2(const void* ptr, u32 n) { const uintptr_t result = uintptr_t(ptr) - uintptr_t(ptr) % n; return reinterpret_cast<void*>(result); } static void* roundDownN(const void* ptr, u32 n) { const uintptr_t result = uintptr_t(ptr) - uintptr_t(ptr) % n; return reinterpret_cast<void*>(result); } static void* addOffset(const void* ptr, intptr_t offset) { return reinterpret_cast<void*>(uintptr_t(ptr) + offset); } static intptr_t diff(const void* ptr1, const void* ptr2) { return intptr_t(ptr1) - intptr_t(ptr2); } static bool isInclude(const void* ptr, const void* begin, const void* end) { return uintptr_t(begin) <= uintptr_t(ptr) && uintptr_t(ptr) <= uintptr_t(end); } static bool isAligned(const void* ptr, s32 alignment) { SEAD_ASSERT(alignment != 0); return uintptr_t(ptr) % alignment == 0; } static bool isAlignedPow2(const void* ptr, u32 n) { return (uintptr_t(ptr) & (n - 1)) == 0; } static bool isAlignedN(const void* ptr, s32 n) { return uintptr_t(ptr) % n == 0; } }; } // namespace sead
